Container.Name: Nginx-Proxy-Manager-MCP
Container.Overview:
MCP server for Nginx Proxy Manager - manage your reverse proxy through AI assistants.
This container exposes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint on port 8000 that AI assistants can use to manage your Nginx Proxy Manager instance: list proxy hosts, create/update/delete hosts, manage SSL certificates, check system health and more.
It has no web interface - connect to it from an MCP client (e.g. Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible agent) using the HTTP transport:
http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:8000/mcp
Before Installing: 1. Make sure you have Nginx Proxy Manager running and note its API URL (http://NPM-IP:81/api) 2. Create an NPM user or use an existing admin account (email + password) 3. Optional: enable the destructive tools (create/update/delete) by setting NPM_MCP_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS=true 4. Optional: set NPM_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN to require a bearer token for MCP clients
For log access (get_proxy_host_logs tool), mount your NPM data directory read-only and set NPM_LOG_DIR accordingly - see the project documentation for details.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: mcp nginx proxy manager npm reverse-proxy ai assistant model-context-protocol

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: MCP server port (HTTP transport). Connect MCP clients to http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:8000/mcp

Config.Name: NPM API URL
Config.Description: Nginx Proxy Manager API endpoint, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:81/api

Config.Name: Enable Destructive Tools
Config.Description: Enable write/destructive tools (create, update, delete, enable, disable). Leave false for read-only access.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token
Config.Description: Optional: bearer token required for MCP HTTP clients. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: MCP Transport
Config.Description: Transport mode: http (default, for remote agents) or stdio

Config.Name: NPM Log Dir
Config.Description: Optional: path to mounted NPM log directory (enables get_proxy_host_logs). Mount NPM's /data/logs read-only and point this at the mount path.

Config.Name: NPM Logs
Config.Description: Optional: mount NPM's log directory here (read-only) and set NPM Log Dir to /data/npm-logs
